name: whimsical-tiles
note: The six approved tile types (slice-b-tiles) redrawn with the whimsical painterly ground rendering, same target colours, same guides (docs/art/slice-b/whimsical.md).

grass.note: Round 2: smaller tufts, today's subtle yellow dots and rare white dots as grass accents (not flowers).
grass.prompt: STYLE REFERENCE: the attached farmhouse panel is from this game; the GRASS around it shows the ground rendering wanted here: painterly, softly textured, a deeper and richer tone with subtle lighter and darker patches, no outline, nothing flat. Render the ground below in THAT rendering while keeping its own colour and content. SUBJECT: a GROUND TEXTURE panel, grass only. The LAST attached image is a layout guide, a 4 x 4 patch of sixteen pale tiles: fill ALL sixteen squares, edge to edge, with exactly the same short meadow grass that surrounds the farmhouse and the stump in the approved panels (the same green, around #79a826 with lighter blades around #8db425, the same soft leafy fill). The fill should read as an almost flat green carpet: the tufts must be SMALL and faint, each no taller than one twentieth of a square, only one or two per square and some squares with none, drawn as a few short darker blades, never as a bush or a clump. Add very subtle accents that are part of the grass: a few tiny pale yellow-green dots the size of a single seed head, only slightly lighter than the grass, and rarely a single tiny white dot. These accents are NOT flowers: no petals, no stems, no circles wider than a blade, no bright yellow blobs. Draw the faint grid lines as thin tile edges exactly where the guide has them. No props, no objects, no characters, no shadows of objects: ground only. Keep the fill even and REPEATABLE: the left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom with no visible seam, no vignette, no lighting gradient across the panel, no feature that only appears once. Do not leave any square pale.

cobble.note: Round 2 retry of cobble-2 (image 8 of 10): cobble-2's moss was bright yellow-green and in most seams; this one asks for muted, rare moss and matte stones.
cobble.prompt: STYLE REFERENCE: the attached farmhouse panel is from this game; the GRASS around it shows the ground rendering wanted here: painterly, softly textured, a deeper and richer tone with subtle lighter and darker patches, no outline, nothing flat. Render the ground below in THAT rendering while keeping its own colour and content. SUBJECT: a GROUND TEXTURE panel, cobblestone only. The LAST attached image is a layout guide, a 4 x 4 patch of sixteen tiles already painted the TARGET COLOUR #acaa89 (a warm khaki grey): keep that as the colour of the cobbles. Fill ALL sixteen squares, edge to edge, with rounded cobbles packed tightly, about five or six cobbles across each square, in the approved panels' recipe: each cobble a flat MATTE lit top with a thin dark outline and a thin shaded lower-right edge, no glossy rim, no wet shine. The seams between cobbles must be VERY THIN, a hairline of dark outline with the cobbles almost touching, no wide mortar, so the paving reads as small and real. Moss: very subtle, a muted dusty green (not bright, not yellow), only in a few seams, about one small patch per square and some squares with none, never on top of a cobble. Keep the cobbles inside each guide square. Draw the faint grid lines as thin tile edges exactly where the guide has them. No props, no objects, no characters, no shadows of objects: ground only.
